strengths: Uses PLCG2, the top original DEG, as the main lineage anchor for microglial/myeloid identity
Appropriately uses negative evidence: absence of neuronal/astrocyte/oligodendrocyte markers among top DEGs
Acknowledges that the large stress-gene component is not cell-type specific
weaknesses: No P2RY12, TMEM119, or CX3CR1 was observed to confirm committed homeostatic microglia
PLCG2 is shared with macrophages/monocytes, so microglia-versus-macrophage exclusivity is not fully resolved
The microglial call rests largely on a single lineage-informative DEG amid a dominant non-specific stress signature

strengths: Correctly recognizes the dominant heat-shock/stress response in the cluster markers
Correctly warns that stress genes such as HSPA1A, HSPA1B, TXNIP, and GADD45B are not cell-type specific
weaknesses: Stress-responsive cell is a cellular state, not a defined cell type in the ontology
All five mapped candidate CLIDs are unrelated to the observed data (stretch receptor cell, tanycyte, strial intermediate cell, serous secreting cell, stromal cell)
Provides no lineage-specific positive evidence to replace the PLCG2 microglial/myeloid anchor

clusterProfiler.predicted_cell_type: CD34-positive, CD38-positive common myeloid progenitor OR CD34-positive, CD38-positive common lymphoid progenitor
strengths: Correctly notes that the HSP/stress genes are not cell-type specific
Correctly notes the absence of mature cortical lineage markers such as NEUROD6, GFAP, and OLIG2
weaknesses: No CD34, CD38, or other hematopoietic progenitor markers are present in the original DEG list
Generic stress/splicing enrichment cannot support a CD34-positive common progenitor branch
Ignores PLCG2, the only lineage-informative DEG, which favors microglial/myeloid identity over common myeloid/lymphoid progenitor

supporting: PLCG2 is the top in-scope DEG and is a canonical microglial/myeloid marker, providing direct positive support for microglial identity
No top DEGs for neurons (e.g., NEUROD6/NEUROD2), astrocytes (e.g., GFAP), or oligodendrocytes (e.g., OLIG2/MBP) support alternative neuroectodermal lineages
Stress markers (HSPA1A, HSPA1B, HSPA6, DNAJB1, HSPH1, TXNIP, GADD45B, CDKN1A) are present but are non-lineage orthogonal signals and do not negate the PLCG2 lineage anchor
conflicting: No P2RY12, TMEM119, or CX3CR1 was observed to confirm homeostatic/committed microglia
PLCG2 is also expressed in macrophages/monocytes, leaving microglia-versus-macrophage exclusivity partially unresolved
The dominant heat-shock signature could reflect dissociation-induced artifact rather than a biological activation state
enrichment_or_literature: Enrichment is dominated by generic stress/housekeeping terms (cellular response to chemical stress, mRNA splicing, cytoplasmic stress granule, Cajal body) that do not discriminate cell lineage
No retrieved PMIDs or curated literature were available to add specificity

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
